brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned the public to prepare for international banking sanctions and proposed cryptocurrency as a potential means to circumvent them, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu's remarks suggest Israel may face financial restrictions as tensions with international bodies escalate.

The prime minister did not specify which countries or institutions might impose sanctions or provide a timeline for when they could take effect.
